gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-malayalam: Bold stencil swagger up top, with Snowburst One's wide bridges cutting between the letters. And Anek Malayalam keeps its curve tips from touching and its x-height nearly at cap level.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anek-telugu: Loud stencil up top, friendly text below. Snowburst One is the bold expressive voice, while Anek Telugu, a sans with wide bowls and unlatched rounds, keeps paragraphs moving at an approachable pace.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-arimo: Arimo keeps a high mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded letters, doing the reading work. But Snowburst One is the one for attention, cutting bold stencil bridges between its letters.
